Name: DEVOUR
Draw: a fat pale grub with a wide ringed maw of inward-facing teeth, caught halfway through biting a card in two, the torn halves curling away from it

Name: SPAWN
Draw: a segmented worm splitting lengthwise into two identical worms, the halves still joined at the tail

Name: EMBER WORM
Draw: a worm of glowing red coal, its segments cracked open like cooling lava with fire showing through the seams

Name: RIME WORM
Draw: a worm sheathed in pale blue ice, frost spreading out from every place its body touches the ground

Name: ARC WORM
Draw: a worm of crackling yellow lightning, its body a jagged bolt with sparks leaping between the segments

Name: LOAM WORM
Draw: a worm armoured in brown stone and packed earth, dirt and small pebbles shedding from its segments as it moves

Name: HEX WORM
Draw: a worm of violet light, its body half transparent and hung about with slowly drifting arcane sigils

Name: WHETWORM
Draw: a worm whose body is a long grey whetstone, throwing a thin line of sparks where a blade is being drawn along it

Name: SWELL
Draw: a worm bloated to twice its length, its skin stretched tight and shining over the bulge

Name: GROW
Draw: a thick heavy worm rearing up off the ground, far broader at the head than at the tail

Name: SHRINK
Draw: a shrivelled worm curled tight and drawn in on itself, its skin hanging loose and wrinkled

Name: TUSK WORM
Draw: a worm with a blunt armoured head like the face of a maul, two short ivory tusks curving up from its jaw

Name: EDGE WORM
Draw: a worm whose body is one long curved blade, the outer edge bright and honed and the inner edge dull

Name: POINT WORM
Draw: a worm tapering along its whole length to a single needle point, its head a narrow spike

Name: SHELL WORM
Draw: a worm coiled inside a thick ridged shell, only its head showing at the opening
